# Pre-build invariant counterexamples

These are algebraic examples using the spec’s own integer curve, not program execution or measured CU.
The donor/holder signs the standard Token-2022 transfer or burn. No launchpad instruction runs, so its cached sold/backing fields do not change. Transfer destinations need not sign.

Fixture: gross buy 101 lamports, net 100, output 3612416 base units; initial mint supply 1000000000000000.

| operation | invariant | equality before | equality after |
|---|---|---|---|
| one door token unit returned directly to DoorVault | B1: DoorRoomVault == U - DoorVault | 3612416 = 3612416 | 3612416 != 3612415 |
| one room token unit returned directly to RoomVault (room-token route) | S1: sold == U - RoomVault | 3612416 = 3612416 | 3612416 != 3612415 |
| holder burns one door token unit | M1: mint.supply == U at all times | 1000000000000000 = 1000000000000000 | 999999999999999 != 1000000000000000 |

The same unsolicited-transfer issue applies to room tokens sent directly into DoorRoomVault.

[Official transfer semantics](https://solana.com/docs/tokens/basics/transfer-tokens); [official burn semantics](https://solana.com/docs/tokens/basics/burn-tokens).
